attributes.title: tag_fixture_probe
attributes.description: CI-only probe that creates the disposable Tag targets the Phase 4 tag_write live cases write to, and reports their paths, initial values and configure QualityCodes.

parameters.name: providerRoot
parameters.description: Provider to create the fixture Tags in, for example default.

parameters.name: rootName
parameters.description: Folder name inside the provider for the allowlisted fixture root.

parameters.name: siblingRootName
parameters.description: Folder name whose path shares a string prefix with rootName.

parameters.name: targets
parameters.description: Tag definitions: name, dataType and initial value.
